title: Russia’s double game in Yemen: Backing Saudi Arabia while courting Houthis
gist: Anton Mardasov argues Russia is playing a double game in Yemen's renewed war — publicly backing the Saudi-supported Presidential Leadership Council and Riyadh (Lavrov calling Houthi attacks 'unacceptable', a Putin-MBS call on Bab el-Mandeb and Hormuz navigation) while allegedly aiding Houthi Red Sea strikes via Iran to pressure the West beyond Ukraine and benefit from energy-market instability.

insights.claim: Russia officially backs Yemen's internationally recognized, Saudi-supported Presidential Leadership Council while simultaneously cultivating ties with the Houthis.
insights.speaker: Anton Mardasov
insights.so_what: Moscow hedges across both sides, preserving its Gulf relationships while retaining leverage over a chokepoint actor.
